text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU OOM spike on pool-eu-central/gpu-17 — metric gpu_mem_util=99% (threshold=88%). signal: cuda:alloc_fail. PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC20250310A

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC20250310A -> fired and notified on-call (maya). escalation policy: 3 min -> oscar.

maya: acknowledged on PD. jumping in — grabbing logs and routing.

derya: FYI support reported abnormal error rate for customer 'newsly' on /v2/chat (errors ~7%).

maya: confirming, traffic shows a large batched job from newsly at 12:45:21 UTC. looks like batch sizes spiked and prefetch behaviour caused KV cache to grow.

support-bot: opened ticket SPT-7782 for newsly and notified account team.

oscar: standing by for handoff if escalation occurs.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) isolate node (no new allocations) 2) throttle heavy tenants 3) migrate active sessions off node -> reroute to pool-eu-west.

maya: isolating node: `infractl node cordon gpu-17 --reason "oom-surge"`

incident-bot: Auto-evict attempted due to fragmentation flag; eviction rate limited by safe-drain policy.

maya: logs show repeated failures: 
```
[2025-03-10T12:45:19Z] model-serve[pid=9821]: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: alloca failed for 2048MB
[2025-03-10T12:45:20Z] model-serve[pid=9821]: kv-cache entries increased +22% in 10s
[2025-03-10T12:45:20Z] runtime: cublasStatusAllocFailed at kernel launch
```

derya: trying soft-throttle on newsly: `routing update --tenant newsly --max-batch 8 --max-concurrency 1`

support-bot: newsly CS reported ~40 requests failed with 503/timeout during the spike; they saw retries from their side. Logged in SPT-7782.

oscar: starting rolling restart of gpu worker on gpu-17 to free fragmented allocations. `infractl svc restart model-worker --node gpu-17`

maya: while restart runs, rerouting traffic: `trafficctl reroute --from pool-eu-central --to pool-eu-west --selector route=/v2/chat`

pagerduty-bot: escalated to oscar at 1745554350 (no ack from escalation within window).

oscar: acked. joining. checking kernel logs for memory fragmentation stats.

maya: restart returned node memory to ~45% but cublas alloc errors persisted intermittently. suspect driver-level fragmentation + one oversized batch.

derya: applied temporary conservative quantization for newsly's workload: `deployctl update --tenant newsly --model chat-xl --quantize fp16 --note "temp mitigate"`

support-bot: customer update sent: "We've mitigated a transient resource issue causing brief errors; we're investigating root cause and will follow up."

maya: action items during incident: apply per-tenant batch caps, add KV-cache soft caps, add metric for fragmentation vs sustained usage, improve alert text to call out cublas vs mem saturation.

oscar: taking post-incident ownership. will own postmortem and customer outreach. assigning task PM-OPS-334.

pagerduty-bot: INC20250310A -> acknowledged by maya at 1745554330, resolved by oscar at 1745554390

maya: summary: cause = oversized batched job from tenant + memory fragmentation on gpu-17 leading to cuda alloc failures. mitigations = cordon+restart, tenant throttle, reroute to other pool, temporary quantization. customer impact: newsly experienced ~40 failed requests (~2% of their minute traffic) for ~90s.

oscar: will file RFC for per-tenant prefetch/batch limits and a driver-level probe for fragmentation. drafting postmortem now.

deray: (typo, meant derya) will follow up on metrics changes.

support-bot: will coordinate final customer note once postmortem draft is ready.

maya: thanks team. shifting status -> monitoring.

incident-bot: Status changed: investigating -> monitoring. logs & graphs attached to INC20250310A.
